title: Wilderness: Numbers and Deuteronomy
subtitle: Numbers, Deuteronomy
theme: Forty years of testing, failing, and being sustained. Moses prepares Israel for the land.
memoryText: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is one. You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your might.
reviewQuestions: What does Israel’s wilderness rebellion reveal about the human heart?
What is the structure of Deuteronomy, and why does it matter that it resembles a covenant treaty?
What does Moses mean by the blessings and curses in Deuteronomy 27-28?
How does Moses function as a type of Christ, and where does he fall short?
psalmsNote: Psalm 90 and Psalms 95, 96, 99, and 100 beside Numbers. Psalms 78 and 119 beside Deuteronomy.
